versions.changelog: 新增五种使用模式、7天验证、进度卡、持续复盘、专项框架和50条回归评测。

- 新增支持 AI 职业转型、本地预约服务和 AI 服务创业等行业专用执行清单
- 增加“快速判断”和“7天低风险实验”为默认交付选项，强调实操验证和进度复盘
- 优化路由、模块拆分与执行流程，按五种典型需求场景自动适配交付深度
- 默认展示完成路径、决策关键点和“进度卡”，强化持续复盘与下一步行动指引
- 新增演示案例和自检机制，提升对零基础用户的友好度与可靠性

- Added README.md and manifest.yaml for clearer documentation and deployment.
- Removed agents/openai.yaml and skill-card.md, simplifying the file structure.
- Updated SKILL.md: streamlined and clarified the description, now emphasizing newbie actionability, practical industry/skill tutorials, and live verification of pricing/policies.
- Expanded supported use cases in both English and Chinese, making guidance coverage and example queries more visible.
- No changes to core workflow or modular execution logic.

- Initial release of "explore-industry-career-paths": a skill for researching industries, explaining occupations, and creating end-to-end beginner guides (English & 中文支持).
- Provides step-by-step master-apprentice style manuals, including practical walk-throughs, resources, costs, troubleshooting, tacit knowledge, and actionable first-opportunity plans.
- Modular approach: routes user requests to the right blend of industry insights, career entry, skill-building, and business validation, with specialized playbooks for some fields.
- Ensures starter guides are actionable for absolute beginners, detailing real steps, tools, platforms, costs, risks, feedback, and "insider" perspectives.
- Includes rigorous sourcing: mandates direct verification and cites for all current resources, costs, or regulatory information.
- Supports both brief fast answers and in-depth tutorials, adapting to user needs and guiding through ambiguity with clear default assumptions.
